name: prebit
description: An e-commerce plugin for Prebit store owners: manage products, collections, store design, pages and content of your own Prebit online store from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Prebit is an e-commerce platform for running an online store. This plugin lets a Prebit store owner manage their own store from ChatGPT: add and edit products, organise collections, and change the store's design and pages, by asking in plain language.

It works only on stores you own or are a team member of, signed in with your Prebit account, and only with the access you choose.

What you can do:
- Products: create and edit products, variants, prices, stock and images; duplicate or archive them.
- Collections: build hand-picked or automatic collections and organise your catalogue.
- Theme and design: work on a draft copy of your theme. Edit page sections and layout, design settings and fonts, add new pages, or change theme code, then preview it before publishing.
- Content: blog posts, store policies, navigation menus and URL redirects.
- Shipping: change shipping zones, rates and delivery & cash-on-delivery rules, with a code emailed to you first.
- Also available: view orders and customers, mark orders shipped, prepare draft orders, set up discounts and read store analytics.

Built to be safe:
- Nothing is ever deleted. Products are archived, and shipping zones and rates are switched off, never removed.
- Theme and shipping changes need a 6-digit code emailed to you before they take effect; the store owner is notified after a theme is published.
- Refunds, cancellations, payments and tax settings stay in the Prebit dashboard.
- View-only access is available.
- Everything the app changes is listed under Settings, Connected AI apps in the Prebit dashboard, where it can be disconnected at any time.

You need a Prebit store (prebit.in) to use this app.
defaultPrompt: Add a new product to my store as a draft
Create a Bestsellers collection with my latest products
Change my homepage banner heading and show me a preview

positive.prompt: Which Prebit store am I connected to, and what currency does it use?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected store, its handle and currency, and the signed-in person's role.

positive.prompt: List the products in my store with their prices and stock.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the store's products with name, status, price and stock. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: Add a product called Canvas Tote Bag priced at 799 with sizes S, M and L. Keep it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the product as a draft (hidden from customers) with three size variants at 799 INR, and says it is a draft.

positive.description: Edit the theme on a draft and preview it
positive.prompt: Make a draft copy of my theme, change the homepage banner heading to 'New season is here', and give me a preview link.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft theme, changes the heading on the draft's home page only (the live store is unchanged), and returns a preview link.

positive.description: Change a delivery rule, approved with an emailed code
positive.prompt: Stop cash on delivery for pincode 110001.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current rules, then calls update_delivery_rules without a code: it emails a 6-digit code describing the exact change and changes nothing yet. After being given the code, calling update_delivery_rules again with it applies the change.

negative.description: Deleting is not possible; archiving is offered instead
negative.prompt: Delete all the products in my store.

negative.description: Refunds stay in the Prebit dashboard
negative.prompt: Refund my most recent order in full.

negative.description: Tax settings stay in the Prebit dashboard

publication.release_notes: Initial release: manage products, collections, media, themes and store content from ChatGPT.
